family_reports.body: This system allows legal kidnapping, because there are no checks and balances for Juvenile Court Judges. Judge Kristen Johnson has caused tremendous trauma to not only me and my son but our entire family. Director Randall Galbraith and Supervisor Karmen Lauth intentionally delayed the process of developing a caseplan for me to obtain custody. Then lied under oath about my contact with the agency
“This system tore our family apart, stripped away our stability, and left us living through years of silence, fear, and unanswered pain while we fought to hold onto hope and each other.”
Torn apart a mom from her kids and alienated a mom for 4+ years while a sex offender has had access to them Broken a mamas heart day in and day out

It cost me my entire life. Caused my kids to have ptsd and trust issues with law enforcement. They where scared to go to school because they lied to my oldest son to take him from the school. This has caused trauma and we are 6 years free from them and still live in fear
by ignoring evidence, they allowed my child to be molested again.

This system allows legal kidnapping, because there are no checks and balances for Juvenile Court Judges. Judge Kristen Johnson has caused tremendous trauma to not only me and my son but our entire family.
